description: Query NOAA/NCEI’s retired Billion-Dollar Weather and Climate Disasters archive (1980–2024), with CPI-adjusted and unadjusted costs and deaths. No years after 2024 are added; CPI adjustments are preserved from the archive, not rebased to current prices. Every cost is in WHOLE US DOLLARS, converted from each export’s declared unit (declaredCostUnit): millions per event, billions per national year, millions per state year. Default calls return individual disasters; summary=true returns per-year counts and costs by class plus an "All Disasters" total. Filter with startYear/endYear (overlapping disasters included), disasterType (exact NCEI class, e.g. "Tropical Cyclone"), minCostInUsd, and state (two-letter postal code). coveredYears reports the span actually present in the export. Under a state scope, per-event rows carry the NATIONAL cost of disasters that reached that state, never a state share, so summing states double-counts; per-year rows carry a binned range instead of a point estimate. Separate from CDO and noaa_climate_search_storm_events; no token required.

disasterType.description: Restrict to one NCEI disaster class, written exactly as NCEI writes it. In summary mode this also drops the "All Disasters" total from each year, leaving only the named class. Optional.

endYear.description: Latest year to include (1980 or later). The retired archive ends in 2024; years past coveredYears.last return no records rather than an error. Optional.

limit.description: Maximum number of disasters or years to return (1–100). Defaults to 50. Larger positive integers are clamped to 100 with a notice unless NOAA_CLAMP_LIMITS=false.

minCostInUsd.description: Floor on CPI-adjusted cost in whole US dollars — 1e9 is one billion. In summary mode this is compared against the year’s "All Disasters" total, or against the named disasterType when one is given; where only a binned range exists, the top of the bin has to clear the floor. Optional.

offset.description: Zero-based index of the first matching record to return. Defaults to 0.

startYear.description: Earliest year to include (1980 or later). A disaster whose span reaches into the range is included even when it began earlier. Optional — omit for the whole record.

state.description: Two-letter US postal code (e.g. "CA", "TX", "PR") scoping the query to NCEI’s per-state export instead of the national one. Per-event rows then carry the national cost of each disaster that reached the state, not a state share; per-year rows carry a binned cost range instead of a point estimate. Optional.

summary.description: Return per-year counts and costs by disaster class instead of individual disasters. Defaults to false.

name: noaa_climate_get_billion_dollar_disasters

cap.description: The limit that was applied. Omitted otherwise.

costBasis.description: Present when a state scope is queried in events mode: every cost below is the NATIONAL cost of a disaster that reached the state, not that state’s share of it, so adding states together double-counts. Omitted for the national scope and in summary mode.

coveredYears.description: The year span the export actually holds, read from its rows.

first.description: Earliest year present in the export.

last.description: Latest year present in this archived export. The retired product covers no years after 2024.

declaredCostUnit.description: The cost unit this export declares in its own preamble, e.g. "millions of dollars". Every cost below is already in whole US dollars; this names the unit it was converted from.

disasters.description: Individual disasters for the requested page. Present when mode is "events".

beginDate.description: Event start as an ISO calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD).

cpiAdjustedCostInUsd.description: Damage in whole US dollars with the CPI adjustment preserved from the archived NCEI export; not rebased to current prices.

deaths.description: Deaths NCEI attributes to the disaster.

disasterType.description: One of NCEI’s seven disaster classes, e.g. "Tropical Cyclone".

endDate.description: Event end as an ISO calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD).

unadjustedCostInUsd.description: Damage in whole US dollars of the year the disaster occurred.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `unknown_state`: The state code is well formed but NCEI publishes no export under it. `invalid_year_range`: startYear is later than endYear, so the range can never match a record. `malformed_export`: The export downloaded but is not the expected table — no header row, no rows, missing columns, or no declared cost unit. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

exhausted.description: True when offset is past the end of a non-empty match set — the page is empty but matches exist. Omitted otherwise.

mode.description: Which shape this response carries: "events" populates disasters, "summary" populates summaries.

notice.description: Archive retirement and preserved CPI-adjustment disclosure, composed with any clamp, empty-page, exhaustion, or truncation guidance.

scope.description: "US" for the national record, or the two-letter state code that was requested.

shown.description: Records returned on this page. Omitted otherwise.

sourceFile.description: The exact NCEI export this response was read from, e.g. "events-US.csv".

summaries.description: Per-year tallies for the requested page. Present when mode is "summary".

items.description: One year of the per-year record.

byDisasterType.description: One entry per class the year’s row carries: the seven disaster classes plus the "All Disasters" total, or only the named class when disasterType was set.

items.description: One disaster class’s tally within the year.

confidenceBoundsInUsd.description: NCEI’s uncertainty bands around costInUsd, in whole US dollars. Published on the national export only; omitted for a state scope, which reports costRangeInUsd instead.

lower75.description: Lower bound of the 75% confidence interval, in whole US dollars.

lower90.description: Lower bound of the 90% confidence interval, in whole US dollars.

lower95.description: Lower bound of the 95% confidence interval, in whole US dollars.

upper75.description: Upper bound of the 75% confidence interval, in whole US dollars.

upper90.description: Upper bound of the 90% confidence interval, in whole US dollars.

upper95.description: Upper bound of the 95% confidence interval, in whole US dollars.

costInUsd.description: CPI-adjusted cost in whole US dollars. Omitted for a state scope, where NCEI publishes costRangeInUsd instead of a point estimate.

costRangeInUsd.description: The cost bin NCEI publishes for a state scope in place of a point estimate. Omitted on the national export.

high.description: Top of the bin, in whole US dollars.

low.description: Bottom of the bin, in whole US dollars.

disasterType.description: One of the seven disaster classes, or "All Disasters" for the year’s total.

eventCount.description: Billion-dollar disasters of this class in the year.

year.description: The calendar year these tallies cover.

totalCount.description: Records matching every filter across the whole export, before offset and limit.

truncated.description: True when more matches exist beyond this page. Omitted otherwise.

title: Get NOAA Billion-Dollar Disasters
